rv.q: In this case, speaking to the unseen can be a dementia symptom but the change means we lose the one candid truth-teller to Lear.

Both bring depth and feeling to their roles, making their part of the story just as moving as Lear’s. Nadine Shah’s Goneril and Lisa Diveney’s Regan are sharp, stylish and dangerous, bringing plenty of bite to their scenes. Dunster keeps the production moving at a strong pace.
Matthew Dunster’s alternative take on Lear is fresh, even fun, with a fine homecoming performance from David Threlfall

Watching his confidence crumble as he loses his power, his family and ultimately his grip on reality is both compelling and heartbreaking. Beneath all the royal bluster is a man desperately trying to hold on to the one thing he’s never really understood: the difference between being feared and being loved.
